title: Holding-Chain Wire
warm:
Holding-chain wire meant [player_name] kept Pell's listening live long enough for Marcus Pell to incriminate the finance-and-tech chain that owned Crownspire's hush. Early thirties, she/her, across-the-hall neighbor—recorder aftertaste, Nolan Greer at her shoulder, Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rising without a body. Four fates open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Wire success did not force any of them.

"He named the holding," Nolan said, mid-forties, cufflinks still for once. "Soft alibi just inherited boardroom teeth. Soft also means Rhea Quinn's slate and Vivienne's perfume never get to be the only witnesses." Elevator chime. Wind sheer. Unused perfume from the bath she should not know. Black car. Wine rings.

[player_name] did not invent a corpse from a wire. She did not invent willing leave. Incrimination only proved silence had a corporate throat—and that Vivienne's cadence could still be method or coincidence depending on which fear she fed. Soft meant pliable evidence with listening aftertaste.

Hope and dread shared the hallway. Across the hall, colder sheets waited.

"Name one fate thread from what the wire caught," Nolan murmured, "or stand fully as cover with me while the holding burns. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the recording."

She catalogued the wire the way Brooks would: holding named, no forced fate, soft still claimed. [player_name] felt Pell's incrimination watching her mouth, and understood that listening had already changed which soft she could still swear.
